==English==
{{was wotd|2026|May|10}}
[[File:Mother with Daughter at Roadside - En Route from Qazvin to Rudbar - Northwestern Iran (7419752832).jpg|thumb|A young [[daughter]] and her mama ''({{senseno|en|mother}})'' or [[mother#Noun|mother]] in [[Iran]].]]

===Etymology 1===
The origin of the {{lg|noun}} is {{uncertain|en|nocap=1}}; it is probably a {{lg|reduplication}} of ''ma'', thought to be a sound made by babies when breastfeeding. The word is possibly influenced by {{cog|frm|maman|t=mother}} (modern {{cog|fr|maman}}), {{m|frm|mamme}} (both probably from {{cog|la|mamma|t=breast; nurse; (''childish'') mother, mama; grandmother}}, probably cognate with {{cog|grc|μᾰ́μμη|t=breast; (''childish'') mother, mama; (''Koine'') grandmother}}, both possibly ultimately from {{cog|ine-pro|*meh₂-|t=to nurse; mama, mother}}), but this is also uncertain as all the words could have developed independently as {{onomatopoeic|en|title={{lg|onomatopoeia}}s}}.<ref name="OED">{{R:OED Online|pos=''n.''{{sup|1}} (and int.)|noformat=1|id=3044075647|date=December 2025|nodot=1}}; {{R:Lexico|pos=n|us=1}}</ref>

{{senseno|en|address for woman|uc=1}} (“(''Caribbean'') ''used as a term of address for a woman''”) is possibly partly from a West African language; compare {{noncog|ak|mmá}}, {{m|ak|mmaa|t=woman}}.<ref name="OED"/>

The {{lg|interjection}}<ref name="OED"/> and {{lg|verb}}<ref>{{R:OED Online|entry=† mama|pos=v|id=714759454|date=July 2023}}</ref> are derived from the noun.

#* {{RQ:Goldsmith She Stoops to Conquer|page=102|passage=Alack, '''mama''', it vvas all your ovvn fault. You vvould be for running avvay by night, vvithout knovving one inch of the vvay.}}

##* {{quote-book|en|year=2003|author=Janice Daugharty|chapter=You’re No Angel Yourself|editor=Hugh Ruppersburg|title=After O’Connor: Stories from Contemporary Georgia|location=Athens, Ga.|publisher=w:University of Georgia Press|page=59|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/afteroconnorstor0000rupp/page/59/mode/1up|isbn=978-0-8203-2556-9|passage=And that's how come Lyniece to volunteer as mama to Son's children. ===Etymology 1===
{{ety|tl|:inh|poz-pro:*mama<ety:inh<map-pro:*mamah>>|tree=1|text=++|id=male}} Compare {{cog|ms|mamak}}. See also {{ncog|sa|माम}}, and {{ncog|ta|மாமா}}.

#: {{ux|tl|Itanong natin sa '''mama''' sa kanto.|Let's ask the '''man''' at the street.}}
#: {{uxi|tl|'''Mama'''ng Ano|'''Mister''' What's-the-name}}

* {{IPAchar|/ma.ma/}} from {{bor|tl|nan-hbl|媽媽|tr=mâ-mâ}}
* {{IPAchar|/ˈmama/}} from {{bor|tl|en|mama}} / {{m|en|momma}}
